vibe: Builds playful, embodied learning and wellbeing agents, and documents the failures as carefully as the wins.
lines: Week 1 I built MAMA, an agent that tries to put a simulated baby to sleep. Turns out feeding it adds gas.
I tried a bunch of tiny in-browser models before WebLLM with Qwen2.5-7B finally held the ACTION format.
kept is my savoring app. Holding the phone to your ear feels way less awkward than talking at a screen.
At LangTable, Jibo got Lucas from almost 0% of the talk to about 24%. It still read as a fail. Thresholds, huh.
Doodlebot once drew a sun after I said 'Thanks, what do you think you should add?' Not a yes! I fixed the matcher.
My median DoodleAgent step took about 26 seconds. Co-drawing needs a faster model.
Group 1 is on personalization for the Course Agent this week.
chatter: was that a yes or not?
